text:
Sam (Finance): Quick check: GCP marketplace invoice for PartnerEdge has an unexpected discount that looks like it applied to committed reserved usage as well as overage. Can someone confirm rules?
Ivy (GCP Partnerships): PartnerEdge was on a committed plan with a negotiated 15% partner discount for overage only, not reserved commit.
Ravi (Billing): Which invoice? INV-2026-05-02. Raw lines: 
invoice_id,sku,partner_id,gross,discount,net
INV-2026-05-02,redwood.gcp.commit,PART-993,20000,3000,17000
INV-2026-05-02,redwood.gcp.overage,PART-993,5000,750,4250
Ravi (Billing): Discount shows 3k on commit line -> 15% of 20k applied which is wrong.
Tess (Revenue Ops): If commit got discounted, need JE and possibly revenue restatement for May close. Tag accounting.
BotAcct: Rule engine notes: RULE_PARTNER_DISCOUNT(PART-993)=0.15 applied to all matched SKUs. Exclusion "commit_exempt" not found on partner metadata.
Ivy (GCP Partnerships): We had asked for the commit_exempt flag in onboarding. Looks like import missed it. I'll check onboarding ticket.
Sam (Finance): Can we reverse the 3k and issue corrected invoice? Also partner expects line-item explanation.
Ravi (Billing): Plan: 1) Create reversal REV-2026-05-02-1 for 3000, 2) Reissue INV-2026-05-02-R1, 3) Attach audit CSV.
Tess (Revenue Ops): Approve reversal pending JE impact note. We'll coordinate for May close.
Ivy (GCP Partnerships): Onboarding ticket shows flag added on 2026-04-10 but migration script dropped it for PART-993. I'll restore metadata and add a check.
Sam (Finance): Please include GL account mapping: sales_discount contra-revenue. We need the reversal to post to same account.
Ravi (Billing): Reversal queued REV-2026-05-02-1 amount 3000 status PENDING_APPROVAL.
Tess (Revenue Ops): Approved. JE required: JE-2026-05-78 created.
Ravi (Billing): Reversal applied, corrected invoice INV-2026-05-02-R1 issued. Email template drafted to partner.
Ivy (GCP Partnerships): Restored commit_exempt tag and added unit test to onboarding pipeline.
Sam (Finance): Partner notified, asked for confirmation they can reconcile.
Ivy (GCP Partnerships): Partner responded: "Thanks, we received corrected invoice and all good"
Tess (Revenue Ops): Closing but allocate follow-up: ensure migration test catches dropped flags.
Ravi (Billing): Noted and closing thread.
BotAcct: Reminder: monitor next billing cycle for PART-993 to ensure no recurrence.
